lines.t: What if every lie you told appeared above your head?
Seven A M. Your mom yells: are you awake?
lines.cap: 7 AM. Your mom yells: are you awake?

lines.t: You say: yeah, I'm up!
A sign appears.
It says: in bed. Eyes closed.
Your mom can see the sign.
Your mom is not happy.
At school, your teacher asks where your homework is.
You say: my dog ate it.
The sign says: I don't have a dog.
The whole class goes silent.
Your crush walks by and says hi.
You say: oh, I didn't see you there.
The sign says: waited here forty minutes.
lines.cap: The sign says: waited here 40 minutes.

lines.t: You start sweating.
At lunch, your friend shows you his drawing.
You say: wow, that's amazing.
The sign says: is that a horse?
It's a picture of you.
After school, someone texts: where are you?
You type: five minutes away.
The sign says: still in the shower.
So you decide to stop lying. Forever.
Then your grandma asks if you like the sweater she made you.
You look at the sweater.
It has three arms.
You say: I love it.
And the sign says...
True.
Somehow.
